text:
Aisha Khan: Noticing 3 similar DB connection blips in the last 6 weeks. Before we finalize fixes in the postmortem, we need a short customer comms plan and an RCA-sharing rule. Quick thread to decide.

Daniel Moore: Agree. Two key asks from customers last time: clearer statuspage wording and an easy way to request technical detail.

Rita Gomez: Pattern note: spikes line up with nightly batch job starts. I'll attach the detection queries to the analysis doc later. For public wording, we should be specific but calm.

Elena Park: From security/legal: public text should be high-level. Full RCAs can be provided on request but default to redacted. Any unredacted sharing requires Legal sign-off and recorded customer consent.

Aisha Khan: Draft decision list: 1) Statuspage blurb: one sentence, e.g. "Intermittent database connectivity impacted a subset of inference requests; mitigations applied and monitoring continues." 2) 72-hour customer summary template (plain language) auto-sent to impacted customers where possible. 3) Full RCA available on request via Support, default redacted; unredacted by exception with Legal.

Daniel Moore: I'll implement a consent checkbox in Support: "I request the full technical report and consent to share logs." Also recommend tagging these incidents `recurring-db-conn` so we can generate trend dashboards.

Rita Gomez: I'll draft the 72-hour template: three bullets — what happened, impact, actions taken + next steps. Keep it non-technical.

Elena Park: I'll produce the redaction checklist and the Legal escalation flow. Target: checklist by Thu, escalation flow by Fri.

incident-bot: Created tasks: INC-DB-3001 (72h template) assigned to Rita Gomez due 2195590000; INC-DB-3002 (support consent checkbox) assigned to Daniel Moore due 2195630000; INC-DB-3003 (redaction checklist) assigned to Elena Park due 2195610000.

Aisha Khan: Owners recap and deadlines: Rita (72h) Tue, Daniel (Support flow) Thu, Elena (redaction) Wed. I'll coordinate customer outreach after the 72h template is ready.

Daniel Moore: For detection, I'm proposing an auto-create rule: if >=2 incidents share the same signature within 21 days, auto-open a mitigation ticket and notify Eng-Platform + Product. Thoughts?

Rita Gomez: 21 days seems reasonable for batch-related patterns. Include sample signature hashes in the analysis doc.

Elena Park: Security fine with auto-ticketing provided tickets are access-controlled and labeled.

Aisha Khan: Let's do a 20-minute sync tomorrow to finalize wording and review the 72h template. I'll send invite for 10:30am PT. Tag me if anything slips.

Daniel Moore: 10:30 works.

Rita Gomez: I'll be there.

incident-bot: Calendar invite created: "DB conn pattern comms review"  10:30 PT tomorrow.

Aisha Khan: Thanks everyone — after the sync I'll post the approved statuspage blurb and the 72h customer note. :white_check_mark:
